name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: Keeps a button pressed or coordinates single and multi-select toggle groups with arrow-key navigation.

files.content:
import './toggle.css'

export {
  createToggleController,
  createToggleGroupController,
  Toggle,
  ToggleGroup,
  ToggleIcon,
} from '@ui-sdk/svelte/toggle'
export type {
  ToggleApi,
  ToggleChangeOptions,
  ToggleController,
  ToggleGroupApi,
  ToggleGroupChangeOptions,
  ToggleGroupController,
  ToggleGroupOptions,
  ToggleGroupOrientation,
  ToggleGroupState,
  ToggleGroupValueChangeReason,
  ToggleIconProps,
  ToggleIconState,
  ToggleOptions,
  TogglePressedChangeReason,
  ToggleState,
} from '@ui-sdk/svelte/toggle'

export type ToggleVariant = 'neutral' | 'outline' | 'ghost'
export type ToggleSize = 'small' | 'normal' | 'large'
